notes.title: Updated the game by replacing some of the videos related to the male protagonist
notes.content:
The first day of the game online, received a lot of players' comments and suggestions, we have seriously listen to and think about it, thank you for your prodding and support ~!
Updated the following contents.
1. Fixed some subtitle problems
2. Fixed some title errors
3. Fixed the problem that the story line has no current location and the exploration degree is always 100%.
4. Fixed the problem that there is no video in the main interface.
5. Completed the node names of the story line in chapter six.
6. Updated some missing content
7. Added the handle indicator picture (not white anymore).
8. Fixed the problem that some nodes in the story line cannot be accessed.
9. Replaced some of the videos related to the main character.
